body: chrome-ext has 3 file-intake routes -> app picks up in apps/chrome-ext/src/app/intercept.ts (order: #fv-inline=<b64> hash, ?openFile=<url>, ?intercept=<sessionkey>). (1) content/handler.ts fetches file:// URL, stashes in chrome.storage.session key 'fv:intercept:<ts>:<rand>', redirects to app; base64-hash fallback if session storage unavailable. (2) service-worker.ts dynamic declarativeNetRequest rule (NOT static — redirect URL needs runtime chrome.runtime.getURL) for csv/tsv downloads, stable rule ids csv=1 tsv=2 for surgical removal on settings change. (3) FSA folder/loose-handle reads in Viewer.tsx.
